default.title: fixture-Kerbside Waste Properties
default.description:
This dataset describes the waste type, suburb, year and count of properties that pay for kerbside pickup of waste, located in Ballarat.

The information was collected as the rates were levied.

The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the number of kerbside waste pickup properties in Ballarat.


This dataset is typically updated yearly on an manual basis.
